subject: Thanks for the time — Redwood discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks for the time — Redwood discovery recap & next steps

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Acme's GenAI plans — really helpful to understand your priorities. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (what I heard):
- Primary goal: reduce per-query latency for customer-facing chat (SLO: < 300ms p95) while cutting token cost by ~30% for scale.
- Constraints: multi-tenant SaaS, SOC 2 required, data residency for EU customers later in rollout.
- Workload: bursty traffic during peak support hours; median seq length ~280 tokens for chat.

Potential Redwood fit:
- Dedicated capacity to ensure predictable throughput + fallbacks to hosted variants for headroom.
- Batching + KV prefix caching to hit latency targets while lowering unit cost.
- Private deployment option for EU region when you lock down residency.

Action items / next steps:
1) I will share a short proposal with estimated costs and a recommended rollout plan (attached).
2) Connor (cc) can run a quick latency validation on a small sample prompt set if you can share 50–100 anonymized examples.
3) Samir/Elena — can you confirm target decision timeline? You mentioned aiming for a proof-of-concept by end of Q1.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-acme-20260220.pdf (proposal summary)

If that looks right, I'd love to schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk Connor through your prompt samples and align on an internal pilot.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
